name: record-build-boundary
goal: A real stamped build yields a schema-valid record that the store loads and history attaches; the record schema stays strict and stale stamps still fail

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Record 9f1794f364fb fails the validator with builds.2 Unrecognized key: stamp. BuildIdentityService.declared spreads the scanned identity, stamp included, into each build; RecordAssemblyService puts executed.builds into the record unprojected; the store saves without validating, so the strict schema refuses only at load, check and attach

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Unchanged product. test/verify-stamped-build.e2e.test.ts (64-hex in /tmp/record-builds-red-hashes.txt): 4 failed, 2 passed: extra stamp key on the worker build; builds.1 Unrecognized key stamp; verify check and history attach say No verification record exists. test/utils/recorded-builds.test.ts on the generated skeleton: 4 failed, 1 passed. Guards passing: schema refuses extra keys, stale stamp refused, public stamp commands

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Projects observed builds into four public fields. Strict schema and stamp checks remain intact. The new utility and assembly dependency are registered.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: 27 unit and 13 integration checks passed; independent review 12/12. Final unchanged E2E red: 5 fail, 2 pass on original assembly. Old invalid record remains untouched.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
